risk_if_not_implemented: Without Post-Employment Requirements Notification, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), Reputational Harm / Loss of Stakeholder Trust (R-EX-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a formal user registration and de-registration process that governs the assignment of access rights.
compensating_control_1.justification: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning (IAC-04) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Post-Employment Requirements Notification (HRS-08.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Personnel Termination
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the termination of individual employment.
compensating_control_2.justification: Personnel Termination (HRS-12) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Post-Employment Requirements Notification (HRS-08.4) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with People applicability. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
